title: JUG GIS Validation Request
description: Wrapped JSON body accepted by POST /validations. The endpoint also accepts a raw buildings_set FeatureCollection directly.

buildings_set_path.description: Path to a GeoJSON file accessible to the running service. In Docker, use a path inside the container such as /data/gis/QuebecCity.geojson.

cleaned_units_num_key.description: Optional feature property containing the number of cleaned units. NULL values contribute one; when omitted, every retained feature contributes one.

area_calculation_mode.description: Use none to disable area comparison, area-only when area_key is already total building area, or area-times-floor to multiply by floor_num_key.

include_height_proxy.description: Include a separate total-area diagnostic using height divided by 3.5 as the floor multiplier.

height_proxy_area_key.description: Optional base-area field used only by the height proxy. Defaults to area_key.

height_proxy_area_fallback_key.description: Optional field used when height_proxy_area_key is unusable. Mutually exclusive with height_proxy_area_fallback_value.

height_proxy_area_fallback_value.description: Optional positive constant fallback. When neither fallback option is supplied, the service uses 80.

unique_attribute_key.description: Optional feature attribute to uniquify for validation. For each non-missing value, the feature with the greatest ranking-area value is retained.

uniquification_area_key.description: Optional area field used only to rank duplicate features. Defaults to area_key.

census_avg_area_by_type.description: Optional override of average dwelling areas by census characteristic label.
